answer: Proof-of-replication audits curb Sybils in agent networks handling tasks like mapping karst aquifers or classifying walnut and yarrow. Each identity seals a key-salted dataset via slow sequential hashing and must answer random Merkle challenges faster than on-the-fly recomputation allows. Because replicas cannot be deduplicated, attackers incur dedicated storage and read IOPS per identity. Still, well-funded operators can rent bulk SSD arrays to run many Sybils.
